decisions.choice: crucified: put to death on a cross
decisions.reason: Crucifixion was the Roman death for slaves and rebels. It was slow and shameful, carried out in public as a warning. Jesus had foretold it (20:19).

decisions.choice: present tense of narration (L); past (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek present tense of narration.

decisions.choice: Have him killed on a cross
decisions.reason: Readable says what crucifixion was.

decisions.choice: ¡Sea crucificado! (L); ¡Que lo crucifiquen! (B); ¡Que lo maten en una cruz! (R); also 27:23
decisions.reason: The Greek is a passive command, "let him be crucified". Literal keeps the passive; Balanced and Readable use the impersonal "que lo ...", the natural Spanish way to call for something to be done to someone. "¡Crucifícalo!" would make Pilate the one addressed, as in John 19:6 where the Greek says so. Readable says what crucifying is (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "Ils disent" (L), the Greek present of narration kept
decisions.reason: Unlike "il dit" in 27:13 and 27:22, the plural shows the tense, so the historic present is visible at Literal here. Balanced and Readable use the past, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Asulubiwe (L, B); Auawe msalabani (R); also 27:23
decisions.reason: The Greek is a passive command, "let him be crucified", and the Swahili passive subjunctive says exactly that. "Msulubishe" would make Pilate the one addressed, as in John 19:6 where the Greek says so. Readable says what crucifying is (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "ông ta" for Jesus in the crowd's cry, with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Mark 15:13: the crowd would not use the reverent "ngài", and their word has no capital form.

decisions.choice: "đóng đinh ... trên cây thập tự" (R); "cây thập tự" for the cross through the passion story
alternatives: "thập tự giá", used in Jesus' sayings and predictions (10:38; 20:19)
decisions.reason: Readable adds "on the cross" so a new reader sees what kind of death is meant, as the English Readable does. The narrative of the crucifixion uses the plain "cây thập tự", as the Vietnamese Mark 15 and John 19 do.

decisions.choice: "십자가에 못 박히게 하시오" (L); "십자가에 못 박으시오" (B); "십자가에 못 박아 죽이시오" (R) for staurotheto, here and in 27:23
decisions.reason: Korean has no third-person passive command; Literal keeps the passive with "-게 하시오", Balanced uses the active of the Korean Mark 15:13, and Readable adds that it is a killing, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Seja crucificado, with no pronoun
decisions.reason: Portuguese gives the third-person command without a subject pronoun, as the Greek does in one word, so there is no deity_pronoun span where the English "him" has one. Readable needs the object "lo" and carries the span.

decisions.choice: "Пусть будет распят!" with no pronoun (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek is one passive verb; Russian Literal can say it without a pronoun, so there is no span where the English has one. Balanced and Readable say it with an object pronoun, which takes the span.

decisions.choice: "прибити до хреста" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 15, Readable says what crucifixion was in everyday words; Literal and Balanced keep "розіпʼясти". The same through the chapter.

decisions.choice: "十字架につけられるがいい" (L); "十字架につけろ" (B); "あいつを十字架につけて殺せ" (R); the same in 27:23
alternatives: "十字架につけろ" at every level, as Mark 15:13
decisions.reason: Matthew has a passive command where Mark has an active one; Literal keeps the passive, and Balanced and Readable use the natural shout. Readable says what crucifixion meant, as the English does.

source.text: ὁ δὲ ἔφη· Τί γὰρ κακὸν ἐποίησεν;

records.literal_gloss: The but said, What for evil did he do?

en.L: But he said, "Why, what evil has {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} done?"
en.B: "But what wrong has {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} done?" Pilate asked.
en.R: Pilate asked, "Why? What bad thing has this man done?"

es.L: Pero él dijo: «Pues ¿qué mal ha hecho?».
es.B: «Pero ¿qué mal ha hecho?», preguntó Pilato.
es.R: Pilato preguntó: «¿Por qué? ¿Qué cosa mala ha hecho este hombre?».

fr.L: Mais il dit : « Quel mal a-t-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} donc fait ? »
fr.B: « Mais quel mal a-t-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait ? » demanda Pilate.
fr.R: Pilate a demandé : « Pourquoi ? Qu’est-ce que cet homme a fait de mal ? »

sw.L: Naye alisema, "Kwa nini, amefanya ubaya gani?"
sw.B: "Lakini amefanya kosa gani?" Pilato aliuliza.
sw.R: Pilato aliuliza, "Kwa nini? Mtu huyu amefanya jambo gani baya?"

vi.L: Nhưng ông nói: "Vậy ông ta đã làm điều ác gì?"
vi.B: Phi-lát hỏi: "Nhưng ông ta đã phạm tội gì?"
vi.R: Phi-lát hỏi: "Tại sao? Người này đã làm điều gì sai?"

ko.L: 그러자 그가 말했다. "도대체 그가 무슨 악한 일을 했느냐?"
ko.B: 빌라도가 물었다. "그가 무슨 잘못을 했단 말이냐?"
ko.R: 빌라도가 물었다. "왜? 이 사람이 무슨 나쁜 짓을 했느냐?"

pt.L: Mas ele disse: "Pois que mal {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez?"
pt.B: "Mas que mal {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez?", perguntou Pilatos.
pt.R: Pilatos perguntou: "Por quê? Que coisa ruim este homem fez?"

am.L: እርሱ ግን፦ «ለምን? ምን ክፉ ነገር አደረገ?» አለ።
am.B: ጲላጦስም፦ «ግን ምን በደል አደረገ?» ብሎ ጠየቀ።
am.R: ጲላጦስም፦ «ለምን? ይህ ሰው ምን መጥፎ ነገር አደረገ?» ብሎ ጠየቀ።

ru.L: Он же сказал: «Какое же зло {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сделал?»
ru.B: «Но что плохого {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сделал?» — спросил Пилат.
ru.R: Пилат спросил: «Почему? Что плохого сделал этот человек?»

hi.L: पर उसने कहा, "क्यों, उसने क्या बुराई की है?"
hi.B: "पर उसने क्या बुराई की है?" पिलातुस ने पूछा।
hi.R: पिलातुस ने पूछा, "क्यों? इस आदमी ने क्या बुरा काम किया है?"

uk.L: А він сказав: «Яке ж зло {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} учинив?»
uk.B: «Але який злочин {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} скоїв?» — запитав Пилат.
uk.R: Пилат запитав: «Чому? Що поганого зробив цей чоловік?»

ja.L: しかし彼は言った。「いったい、どんな悪いことをしたというのか？」
ja.B: 「いったい、どんな悪いことをしたというのか？」とピラトは言った。
ja.R: ピラトは聞きました。「どうしてだ？この男が何か悪いことをしたのか？」

decisions.choice: for: a word of protest, why, what then
decisions.reason: In a question the word adds force: why, what has he done?

decisions.choice: Pilate
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the speaker.

decisions.choice: "ông ta", "người này" in Pilate's mouth, with no setting span
decisions.reason: Pilate's own words for Jesus, as in the Vietnamese Mark 15:14 and John 19:4, have no reverent capital form.

source.text: οἱ δὲ περισσῶς ἔκραζον λέγοντες· Σταυρωθήτω.

records.literal_gloss: They but all the more were crying out saying, Let him be crucified.

en.L: But they kept crying out all the more, saying, "Let {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} be crucified!"
en.B: But they only shouted louder and louder, "Let {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} be crucified!"
en.R: But the people shouted even louder, "Have {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} killed on a cross!"

es.L: Pero ellos gritaban aún más, diciendo: «¡Sea crucificado!».
es.B: Pero ellos gritaban cada vez más fuerte: «¡Que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} crucifiquen!».
es.R: Pero la gente gritó todavía más fuerte: «¡Que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} maten en una cruz!».

fr.L: Mais eux criaient d’autant plus, disant : « Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} soit crucifié ! »
fr.B: Mais ils crièrent de plus en plus fort : « Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} soit crucifié ! »
fr.R: Mais les gens ont crié encore plus fort : « Fais-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} clouer sur une croix ! »

sw.L: Lakini wao walizidi kupiga kelele, wakisema, "Asulubiwe!"
sw.B: Lakini wao walizidi kupaza sauti, "Asulubiwe!"
sw.R: Lakini watu walipiga kelele kwa nguvu zaidi, "Auawe msalabani!"

vi.L: Nhưng họ càng la lớn hơn nữa, nói: "Hãy để ông ta bị đóng đinh!"
vi.B: Nhưng họ càng la to hơn: "Đóng đinh ông ta đi!"
vi.R: Nhưng dân chúng càng la to hơn nữa: "Hãy đóng đinh ông ta trên cây thập tự!"

ko.L: 그러나 그들은 더욱 소리 지르며 말하고 있었다. "그가 십자가에 못 박히게 하시오!"
ko.B: 그러나 그들은 더욱 크게 소리를 질렀다. "십자가에 못 박으시오!"
ko.R: 그러나 사람들은 더 크게 소리쳤다. "그 사람을 십자가에 못 박아 죽이시오!"

pt.L: Mas eles gritavam ainda mais, dizendo: "Seja crucificado!"
pt.B: Mas eles gritavam cada vez mais alto: "Que seja crucificado!"
pt.R: Mas o povo gritou ainda mais alto: "Mande matá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} numa cruz!"

am.L: እነርሱ ግን፦ «ይሰቀል!» እያሉ አብዝተው ይጮኹ ነበር።
am.B: እነርሱ ግን ድምፃቸውን ይበልጥ ከፍ አድርገው፦ «ይሰቀል!» እያሉ ጮኹ።
am.R: ሕዝቡ ግን ይበልጥ ከፍ ባለ ድምፅ፦ «በመስቀል ላይ ተሰቅሎ ይገደል!» ብለው ጮኹ።

ru.L: Они же ещё сильнее кричали, говоря: «Пусть будет распят!»
ru.B: Но они закричали ещё громче: «Распять {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}!»
ru.R: Но люди закричали ещё громче: «Казни {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} на кресте!»

hi.L: पर वे यह कहते हुए और भी अधिक चिल्लाने लगे, "वह क्रूस पर चढ़ाया जाए!"
hi.B: पर वे और भी ज़ोर से चिल्लाते रहे, "उसे क्रूस पर चढ़ाया जाए!"
hi.R: पर लोग और भी ज़ोर से चिल्लाए, "उसे क्रूस पर चढ़ाकर मार डालो!"

uk.L: А вони ще дужче кричали, кажучи: «Нехай буде розіпʼятий!»
uk.B: Але вони кричали все голосніше: «Нехай {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} розіпнуть!»
uk.R: Але люди закричали ще голосніше: «Прибийте {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} до хреста!»

ja.L: しかし彼らはますます激しく叫び続けて言った。「十字架につけられるがいい！」
ja.B: しかし彼らは、いっそう激しく叫び続けた。「十字架につけろ！」
ja.R: でも人々は、もっと大きな声で叫びました。「あいつを十字架につけて殺せ！」

decisions.choice: kept crying out all the more: the shouting grew and went on
decisions.reason: The tense shows a shout repeated again and again, growing louder.

source.text: ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ Πιλᾶτος ὅτι οὐδὲν ὠφελεῖ ἀλλὰ μᾶλλον θόρυβος γίνεται λαβὼν ὕδωρ ἀπενίψατο τὰς χεῖρας ἀπέναντι τοῦ ὄχλου λέγων· Ἀθῷός εἰμι ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος τούτου· ὑμεῖς ὄψεσθε.

records.literal_gloss: Having seen then the Pilate that nothing it avails but rather a riot is arising, having taken water he washed the hands before the crowd saying, Innocent I am of the blood this; you will see.

en.L: And when Pilate saw that he was gaining nothing, but rather a riot was starting, he took water and washed [his] hands before the crowd, saying, "I am innocent of this blood; you will see [to it]."
en.B: Pilate saw that he was getting nowhere and that an uproar was starting instead. So he took water and washed his hands in front of the crowd. "I am not guilty of this man's death," he said. "That is your affair."
en.R: Pilate saw that he could not change their minds. Instead, the crowd was starting to riot. So he took some water and washed his hands in front of them. He said, "I am not to blame for this man's death. You are responsible for it."

es.L: Y viendo Pilato que nada lograba, sino que más bien se formaba un tumulto, tomando agua, se lavó las manos delante de la multitud, diciendo: «Inocente soy de esta sangre; {{plural_you:ustedes verán|vosotros veréis}}».
es.B: Pilato vio que no conseguía nada y que, en cambio, se estaba formando un alboroto. Entonces tomó agua y se lavó las manos delante de la multitud. «No soy culpable de la muerte de este hombre», dijo. «Es asunto {{plural_you:de ustedes|vuestro}}».
es.R: Pilato vio que no podía hacerles cambiar de opinión. Al contrario, la gente estaba empezando a alborotarse. Así que tomó agua y se lavó las manos delante de ellos. Dijo: «Yo no tengo la culpa de la muerte de este hombre. {{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} los responsables».

fr.L: Or Pilate, voyant qu’il ne gagnait rien, mais qu’au contraire un tumulte se produisait, prit de l’eau et se lava les mains devant la foule, disant : « Je suis innocent de ce sang ; vous, vous verrez. »
fr.B: Pilate vit qu’il n’arrivait à rien et qu’au contraire une émeute commençait. Il prit donc de l’eau et se lava les mains devant la foule. « Je ne suis pas coupable de la mort de cet homme, dit-il. C’est votre affaire. »
fr.R: Pilate a vu qu’il ne pouvait pas les faire changer d’avis. Au contraire, la foule commençait à s’agiter. Alors il a pris de l’eau et il s’est lavé les mains devant tout le monde. Il a dit : « Je ne suis pas responsable de la mort de cet homme. C’est vous qui en êtes responsables. »

sw.L: Na Pilato, alipoona kwamba hafaulu kitu, bali ghasia inaanza, alichukua maji, akanawa mikono mbele ya umati, akisema, "Sina hatia ya damu hii; ninyi mtaona."
sw.B: Pilato aliona kwamba hapati mafanikio yoyote, bali badala yake fujo zilikuwa zinaanza. Basi alichukua maji, akanawa mikono mbele ya umati, akasema, "Sina hatia juu ya kifo cha mtu huyu. Hilo ni shauri lenu."
sw.R: Pilato aliona kwamba hangeweza kubadilisha mawazo yao. Badala yake, watu walikuwa wanaanza kufanya fujo. Basi alichukua maji, akanawa mikono mbele yao. Akasema, "Mimi sina lawama kwa kifo cha mtu huyu. Ninyi ndio mnaohusika."

vi.L: Khi Phi-lát thấy mình chẳng được ích gì, mà trái lại cuộc náo loạn đang nổi lên, ông lấy nước rửa tay trước mặt đám đông và nói: "Tôi vô tội về huyết này; các người hãy tự lo lấy."
vi.B: Phi-lát thấy mình không làm được gì, mà trái lại dân chúng sắp nổi loạn. Vì vậy ông lấy nước rửa tay trước mặt đám đông và nói: "Tôi vô can trong cái chết của người này. Đó là việc của các người."
vi.R: Phi-lát thấy ông không thể làm cho họ đổi ý. Trái lại, đám đông sắp nổi loạn. Vì vậy ông lấy nước rửa tay trước mặt họ. Ông nói: "Tôi không chịu trách nhiệm về cái chết của người này. Các người phải chịu trách nhiệm."

ko.L: 그런데 빌라도는 아무 소용이 없고 오히려 소동이 일어나는 것을 보고, 물을 가져다가 무리 앞에서 손을 씻으며 말했다. "나는 이 피에 대하여 죄가 없다. 너희가 알아서 하여라."
ko.B: 빌라도는 아무 소용이 없고 오히려 소동이 일어나려는 것을 보았다. 그래서 물을 가져다가 무리 앞에서 손을 씻으며 말했다. "나는 이 사람의 죽음에 책임이 없다. 그것은 너희 일이다."
ko.R: 빌라도는 사람들의 마음을 바꿀 수 없다는 것을 알았다. 오히려 사람들이 폭동을 일으키려 하고 있었다. 그래서 빌라도는 물을 가져다가 사람들 앞에서 손을 씻었다. 그리고 말했다. "나는 이 사람이 죽는 것에 책임이 없다. 책임은 너희에게 있다."

pt.L: E Pilatos, vendo que nada conseguia, mas que, ao contrário, um tumulto estava começando, tomou água e lavou as mãos diante da multidão, dizendo: "Sou inocente deste sangue; vocês verão [isso]."
pt.B: Pilatos viu que não estava conseguindo nada e que, em vez disso, começava um tumulto. Então pegou água e lavou as mãos diante da multidão. "Não sou culpado da morte deste homem", disse ele. "O problema é de vocês."
pt.R: Pilatos viu que não conseguia fazer o povo mudar de ideia. Pelo contrário, a multidão estava começando a fazer uma confusão. Então ele pegou um pouco de água e lavou as mãos na frente de todos. Ele disse: "Eu não tenho culpa da morte deste homem. A responsabilidade é de vocês."

am.L: ጲላጦስም ምንም እንዳልጠቀመ ይልቁንም ሁከት እንደሚነሣ ባየ ጊዜ ውኃ ወስዶ በሕዝቡ ፊት እጆቹን ታጠበና፦ «እኔ ከዚህ ደም ንጹሕ ነኝ፤ እናንተው ተመልከቱት» አለ።
am.B: ጲላጦስ ምንም ሊያደርግ እንዳልቻለና ይልቁንም ሁከት እየተነሣ እንደ ሆነ አየ። ስለዚህ ውኃ ወስዶ በሕዝቡ ፊት እጆቹን ታጠበ። «በዚህ ሰው ሞት በደል የለብኝም» አለ፤ «ጉዳዩ የእናንተ ነው።»
am.R: ጲላጦስ ሕዝቡን ሊያሳምን እንደማይችል አየ። ይልቁንም ሕዝቡ ሁከት ማስነሣት ጀምሮ ነበር። ስለዚህ ውኃ ወስዶ በፊታቸው እጆቹን ታጠበ። እንዲህም አለ፦ «ለዚህ ሰው ሞት እኔ ተጠያቂ አይደለሁም። ተጠያቂዎቹ እናንተ ናችሁ።»

ru.L: Пилат же, увидев, что ничто не помогает, а, напротив, начинается волнение, взяв воду, умыл руки перед толпой, говоря: «Невиновен я в крови этой; вы увидите.»
ru.B: Пилат увидел, что ничего не добьётся, а начинается беспорядок. Тогда он взял воды и умыл руки перед толпой. «Я не виновен в смерти этого человека», — сказал он. «Это ваше дело.»
ru.R: Пилат увидел, что не может их переубедить. Наоборот, толпа вот-вот взбунтуется. Тогда он взял воды и вымыл руки у всех на глазах. Он сказал: «Я не виноват в смерти этого человека. Отвечать за неё будете вы.»

hi.L: जब पिलातुस ने देखा कि कुछ बन नहीं पड़ता, पर उलटे हुल्लड़ बढ़ता जा रहा है, तो उसने पानी लेकर भीड़ के सामने [अपने] हाथ धोए, यह कहते हुए, "मैं इस लहू से निर्दोष हूँ; तुम ही देखो।"
hi.B: पिलातुस ने देखा कि उसकी कुछ नहीं चल रही, बल्कि दंगा भड़कने लगा है। तब उसने पानी लेकर भीड़ के सामने अपने हाथ धोए। "मैं इस मनुष्य की मृत्यु का दोषी नहीं हूँ," उसने कहा। "यह तुम्हारा मामला है।"
hi.R: पिलातुस ने देखा कि वह उनका मन नहीं बदल सकता। उलटे भीड़ दंगा करने लगी थी। तब उसने थोड़ा पानी लिया और उनके सामने अपने हाथ धोए। उसने कहा, "इस आदमी की मौत का दोष मुझ पर नहीं है। इसके ज़िम्मेदार तुम हो।"

uk.L: А Пилат, побачивши, що нічого не допомагає, а радше заворушення починається, узявши води, умив руки перед натовпом, кажучи: «Невинний я в крові цього; ви дивіться.»
uk.B: Пилат побачив, що нічого не досягне, а натомість починається заворушення. Тоді він узяв води й умив руки перед натовпом. «Я не винен у смерті цього чоловіка», — сказав він. — «Це ваша справа.»
uk.R: Пилат побачив, що не зможе їх переконати. Натомість натовп от-от збунтується. Тож він узяв води й умив руки перед людьми. Він сказав: «Я не винен у смерті цього чоловіка. Відповідаєте за це ви.»

ja.L: ピラトは、何の効果もなく、かえって騒ぎが起ころうとしているのを見て、水を取り、群衆の前で手を洗って言った。「わたしはこの血について罪がない。おまえたちが[自分で]始末しろ。」
ja.B: ピラトは、何をしてもむだで、かえって騒ぎが起こりそうなのを見ると、水を取り、群衆の前で手を洗った。「この男の死について、わたしには責任がない」と彼は言った。「自分たちで始末をつけろ。」
ja.R: ピラトは、人々の考えを変えることはできないとわかりました。それどころか、群衆が暴動を起こしそうでした。それでピラトは水を取って、群衆の前で手を洗いました。そして言いました。「この男が死んでも、わたしのせいではない。それは、おまえたちの責任だ。」

decisions.choice: washing the hands: a sign of declaring oneself innocent of a death
decisions.reason: The law gives this act to the elders of a town after an unsolved killing (Deuteronomy 21:6-9), and the psalms speak of washing the hands in innocence (Psalm 26:6; 73:13). Pilate uses a sign the crowd would understand.

decisions.choice: this blood: the blood of this man
decisions.reason: The words can be read "this blood" or "the blood of this man". Either way they mean Jesus's death.

decisions.choice: of this blood, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: of the blood of this righteous man, the reading of many manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts read "of the blood of this righteous man", echoing 27:19. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: you will see to it: the responsibility is yours
decisions.reason: Pilate uses the words the priests used to Judas in 27:4, and passes the matter to the crowd. Washing his hands does not undo his own order (27:26).

decisions.choice: not guilty of this man's death (B); not to blame for this man's death (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say plainly what the idiom of blood means.

decisions.choice: ustedes verán (L); Es asunto de ustedes (B)
decisions.reason: Pilate turns on the crowd the words the chief priests used to Judas in 27:4 ("Tú verás", "Eso es asunto tuyo"); the responsibility is theirs (meaning decision m4). Literal and Balanced repeat the wording of 27:4 so that the echo can be heard.

decisions.choice: ninyi mtaona (L); Hilo ni shauri lenu (B)
decisions.reason: Pilate turns on the crowd the words the chief priests used to Judas in 27:4 ("Wewe utaona", "Hilo ni shauri lako"); the responsibility is theirs (meaning decision m4). Literal and Balanced repeat the wording of 27:4 so that the echo can be heard.

decisions.choice: "huyết này" (L); "cái chết của người này" (B, R); "các người hãy tự lo lấy" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek "blood" with the Bible word "huyết", and Balanced and Readable say whose death is meant (meaning decision); "tự lo lấy" repeats the leaders' words to Judas in 27:4, as the Greek does.

decisions.choice: "이 피에 대하여" (L); "이 사람의 죽음에" (B); "이 사람이 죽는 것에" (R)
decisions.reason: This blood is the blood of this man (meaning decision); Literal keeps the Greek picture, Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: O problema é de vocês
decisions.reason: The same words as the priests' answer to Judas in 27:4 (m4), now plural; "de vocês" because Pilate speaks to the crowd.

decisions.choice: "おまえたちが[自分で]始末しろ" (L); "自分たちで始末をつけろ" (B); "おまえたちの責任だ" (R)
decisions.reason: Pilate uses the priests' words to Judas (27:4, m4), so the wording repeats theirs, in the plural.

source.text: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς πᾶς ὁ λαὸς εἶπεν· Τὸ αἷμα αὐτοῦ ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ τέκνα ἡμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: And answering all the people said, The blood of him on us and on the children of us.

en.L: And all the people answered and said, "His blood [be] on us and on our children!"
en.B: All the people there answered, "Let the guilt for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} death fall on us and on our children!"
en.R: All the people there shouted back, "We and our children will take the blame for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} death!"

es.L: Y respondiendo todo el pueblo, dijo: «¡Su sangre [sea] sobre nosotros y sobre nuestros hijos!».
es.B: Todo el pueblo que estaba allí respondió: «¡Que la culpa de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} muerte caiga sobre nosotros y sobre nuestros hijos!».
es.R: Toda la gente que estaba allí le gritó: «¡Nosotros y nuestros hijos cargaremos con la culpa de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} muerte!».

fr.L: Et tout le peuple, répondant, dit : « Son sang [soit] sur nous et sur nos enfants ! »
fr.B: Tout le peuple présent répondit : « Que la responsabilité de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} mort retombe sur nous et sur nos enfants ! »
fr.R: Tous les gens qui étaient là ont crié : « Nous prenons sur nous la responsabilité de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} mort, nous et nos enfants ! »

sw.L: Na watu wote wakajibu, wakasema, "Damu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} [na iwe] juu yetu na juu ya watoto wetu!"
sw.B: Watu wote waliokuwa pale walijibu, "Hatia ya kifo {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} na iwe juu yetu na juu ya watoto wetu!"
sw.R: Watu wote waliokuwa pale walimjibu kwa kelele, "Sisi na watoto wetu tutabeba lawama ya kifo {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}}!"

vi.L: Và toàn dân đáp lại và nói: "Máu ông ta [đổ] trên chúng tôi và trên con cái chúng tôi!"
vi.B: Toàn thể dân chúng ở đó đáp: "Xin cho tội làm đổ máu ông ta đổ trên chúng tôi và trên con cháu chúng tôi!"
vi.R: Tất cả dân chúng ở đó la lên: "Chúng tôi và con cháu chúng tôi sẽ chịu trách nhiệm về cái chết của ông ta!"

ko.L: 그러자 온 백성이 대답하여 말했다. "그의 피는 우리와 우리 자녀들에게 [돌리시오]!"
ko.B: 그러자 거기 있던 모든 백성이 대답했다. "그의 죽음에 대한 책임은 우리와 우리 자녀들이 지겠소!"
ko.R: 거기 있던 모든 사람이 소리쳐 대답했다. "그 사람이 죽는 책임은 우리와 우리 자녀들이 지겠소!"

pt.L: E todo o povo, respondendo, disse: "O sangue {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} [caia] sobre nós e sobre os nossos filhos!"
pt.B: Todo o povo que estava ali respondeu: "Que a culpa pela morte {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} caia sobre nós e sobre os nossos filhos!"
pt.R: Todas as pessoas que estavam ali gritaram: "Nós e os nossos filhos assumimos a culpa pela morte {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}!"

am.L: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ መልሰው፦ «ደሙ በእኛና በልጆቻችን ላይ [ይሁን]!» አሉ።
am.B: በዚያ የነበሩት ሕዝብ ሁሉ፦ «የሞቱ በደል በእኛና በልጆቻችን ላይ ይሁን!» ብለው መለሱ።
am.R: በዚያ የነበሩት ሕዝብ ሁሉ፦ «ለሞቱ እኛና ልጆቻችን ተጠያቂዎች እንሆናለን!» ብለው ጮኹ።

ru.L: И весь народ в ответ сказал: «Кровь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} на нас и на детях наших!»
ru.B: Весь народ, бывший там, ответил: «Пусть вина за {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} смерть падёт на нас и на наших детей!»
ru.R: Все люди, которые там были, закричали в ответ: «Мы и наши дети возьмём вину за {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} смерть на себя!»

hi.L: और सब लोगों ने उत्तर देकर कहा, "उसका लहू हम पर और हमारी सन्तान पर [हो]!"
hi.B: वहाँ के सब लोगों ने उत्तर दिया, "उसकी मृत्यु का दोष हम पर और हमारी सन्तान पर पड़े!"
hi.R: वहाँ के सब लोग चिल्लाकर बोले, "उसकी मौत का दोष हम और हमारे बच्चे अपने ऊपर लेते हैं!"

uk.L: І весь народ, відповідаючи, сказав: «Кров {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} на нас і на дітях наших!»
uk.B: Увесь народ, що був там, відповів: «Нехай вина за {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} смерть упаде на нас і на наших дітей!»
uk.R: Усі люди, що були там, закричали у відповідь: «Ми і наші діти візьмемо на себе вину за {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} смерть!»

ja.L: すると民全体が答えて言った。「その者の血は、わたしたちとわたしたちの子どもたちの上に[かかってもよい]！」
ja.B: そこにいた民は皆、答えた。「その男の死の責任は、わたしたちと、わたしたちの子どもたちが負ってもよい！」
ja.R: そこにいた人々はみな、叫び返しました。「あの男が死んだ責任は、わたしたちと子どもたちが引き受ける！」

decisions.choice: his blood be on us: we accept the guilt for his death
alternatives: a wish to be cleansed by his blood
decisions.reason: The phrase takes on responsibility for a death (2 Samuel 1:16; Jeremiah 26:15; Acts 5:28). The crowd answers Pilate's claim to be innocent of this blood (27:24).

decisions.choice: the cry of this crowd at that moment
alternatives: a curse on the Jewish people for all time
decisions.reason: The words are the shout of the crowd gathered before Pilate that morning, whom their leaders had persuaded (27:20). Matthew reports what they said. The verse has been used to blame the Jewish people as a whole for Jesus's death and to justify hatred of Jews; the text does not support that use. Jesus, his disciples and the women at the cross were Jews, and in Matthew Jesus's blood is poured out for the forgiveness of sins for many (26:28).

decisions.choice: all the people: those present who answered Pilate
decisions.reason: Matthew here uses the word "people", often used of Israel, in place of "crowd". The context limits it to those who stood before Pilate and answered him. Some read the change of word as making the crowd stand for the nation; the sentence itself speaks of those present.

decisions.choice: Let the guilt for his death fall on us (B); take the blame for his death (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the idiom means. Literal keeps the words of the cry.

decisions.choice: there
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear that the people are those present.

decisions.choice: la responsabilité de sa mort (B, R)
decisions.reason: The idiom means accepting the guilt for his death (m1). "La culpabilité" is heavier and less usual in a cry; "que la responsabilité retombe sur nous" is how French says that someone takes the blame. Literal keeps the words of the cry.

decisions.choice: Damu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}
alternatives: Damu yake written plain, as the English "His blood"
decisions.reason: The English writes "His" plain because it begins the sentence. In Swahili the possessive follows the noun, so it is not sentence-initial and takes the reader setting, as at John 18:36.

decisions.choice: "ông ta" in the crowd's cry, with no setting span
decisions.reason: The crowd's own word for Jesus has no capital form, so the English span on "his" has no counterpart. Balanced and Readable say what the idiom means, accepting the guilt for his death (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: [돌리시오] (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek has no verb ("his blood on us"); Korean needs one, and the crowd's 하오체 to Pilate carries the sense that they take the guilt on themselves (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} in the crowd's cry (L)
decisions.reason: The English Literal has no span here because "His" begins the cry; in Russian the pronoun follows "Кровь", so it takes the usual span.

decisions.choice: "民" (L, B), kept apart from "群衆"; "人々" (R)
decisions.reason: Matthew changes from "crowd" to "people" here (m3); Japanese marks the change, and Balanced and Readable say "そこにいた", as the English does, so the words stay with those present (m2).

source.text: τότε ἀπέλυσεν αὐτοῖς τὸν Βαραββᾶν, τὸν δὲ Ἰησοῦν φραγελλώσας παρέδωκεν ἵνα σταυρωθῇ.

records.literal_gloss: Then he released to them the Barabbas, the but Jesus having flogged he handed over that he might be crucified.

en.L: Then he released Barabbas to them, but after having Jesus flogged, he handed [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}] over to be crucified.
en.B: So Pilate let Barabbas go free, as they wanted. As for Jesus, Pilate ordered {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to be scourged, and then handed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} over for crucifixion.
en.R: Then Pilate set Barabbas free for the people. He had his soldiers beat Jesus with whips. Then he handed Jesus over to be killed on a cross.

es.L: Entonces les soltó a Barrabás, pero a Jesús, después de hacerlo azotar, [{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}] entregó para que fuera crucificado.
es.B: Así que Pilato dejó libre a Barrabás, como querían. En cuanto a Jesús, Pilato mandó que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} azotaran, y luego {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} entregó para que fuera crucificado.
es.R: Entonces Pilato soltó a Barrabás para la gente. Mandó a sus soldados que azotaran a Jesús. Después entregó a Jesús para que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} mataran en una cruz.

fr.L: Alors il leur relâcha Barabbas ; mais Jésus, après {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avoir fait flageller, il [{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}] livra pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} soit crucifié.
fr.B: Pilate libéra donc Barabbas, comme ils le voulaient. Quant à Jésus, il {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} fit flageller, puis {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} livra pour qu’on {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} crucifie.
fr.R: Alors Pilate a libéré Barabbas pour les gens. Il a ordonné à ses soldats de frapper Jésus à coups de fouet. Puis il {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a livré pour qu’on {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} cloue sur une croix.

sw.L: Kisha aliwafungulia Baraba, lakini Yesu, akiisha kumpigisha mijeledi, alimkabidhi ili asulubiwe.
sw.B: Basi Pilato alimwachilia huru Baraba, kama walivyotaka. Kuhusu Yesu, Pilato aliamuru apigwe mijeledi, kisha akamkabidhi ili asulubiwe.
sw.R: Kisha Pilato aliwafungulia watu Baraba. Akawaamuru askari wake wampige Yesu mijeledi. Kisha akamkabidhi Yesu ili auawe msalabani.

vi.L: Bấy giờ ông tha Ba-ra-ba cho họ, còn Đức Giê-xu thì sau khi đánh roi, ông nộp [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] để bị đóng đinh.
vi.B: Vậy Phi-lát thả Ba-ra-ba cho họ, như họ muốn. Còn Đức Giê-xu thì ông cho lính đánh roi, rồi nộp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để đem đi đóng đinh.
vi.R: Rồi Phi-lát thả Ba-ra-ba cho dân chúng. Ông cho lính lấy roi đánh Đức Giê-xu. Rồi ông nộp Đức Giê-xu cho họ đem đi đóng đinh trên cây thập tự.

ko.L: 그때 그는 바라바를 그들에게 놓아주고, 예수는 채찍질한 뒤에 십자가에 못 박히도록 넘겨주었다.
ko.B: 그래서 빌라도는 그들이 원하는 대로 바라바를 풀어 주었다. 그리고 예수를 채찍질하게 한 뒤, 십자가에 못 박도록 넘겨주었다.
ko.R: 그러자 빌라도는 사람들에게 바라바를 풀어 주었다. 그리고 병사들을 시켜 예수를 채찍으로 때리게 했다. 그다음에 예수를 십자가에 못 박도록 넘겨주었다.

pt.L: Então lhes soltou Barrabás; mas, depois de mandar açoitar Jesus, [{{deity_pronoun:o|O}}] entregou para ser crucificado.
pt.B: Então Pilatos soltou Barrabás, como eles queriam. Quanto a Jesus, Pilatos mandou que {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} açoitassem e depois {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} entregou para ser crucificado.
pt.R: Então Pilatos soltou Barrabás para o povo. Ele mandou os seus soldados chicotearem Jesus. Depois entregou Jesus para ser morto numa cruz.

am.L: በዚያን ጊዜ በርባንን ፈታላቸው፤ ኢየሱስን ግን ካስገረፈው በኋላ እንዲሰቀል አሳልፎ ሰጠው።
am.B: ስለዚህ ጲላጦስ እንደ ፈለጉት በርባንን ፈታላቸው። ኢየሱስን ግን እንዲገረፍ አዘዘ፤ ከዚያም እንዲሰቀል አሳልፎ ሰጠው።
am.R: ከዚያም ጲላጦስ በርባንን ለሕዝቡ ፈታላቸው። ወታደሮቹ ኢየሱስን በጅራፍ እንዲገርፉት አደረገ። ከዚያም ኢየሱስ በመስቀል ላይ እንዲገደል አሳልፎ ሰጠው።

ru.L: Тогда он отпустил им Варавву, а Иисуса, бичевав, передал, чтобы {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} был распят.
ru.B: Тогда Пилат отпустил им Варавву, как они хотели. А Иисуса он приказал бичевать и затем отдал на распятие.
ru.R: Тогда Пилат отпустил Варавву на свободу. Он велел солдатам избить Иисуса плетьми. Потом он отдал Иисуса, чтобы {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} казнили на кресте.

hi.L: तब उसने बरअब्बा को उनके लिए छोड़ दिया, पर यीशु को कोड़े लगवाकर क्रूस पर चढ़ाए जाने के लिए [उन्हें] सौंप दिया।
hi.B: तब पिलातुस ने उनकी इच्छा के अनुसार बरअब्बा को छोड़ दिया। और यीशु को उसने कोड़े लगवाने की आज्ञा दी, और फिर उन्हें क्रूस पर चढ़ाए जाने के लिए सौंप दिया।
hi.R: तब पिलातुस ने लोगों के लिए बरअब्बा को छोड़ दिया। उसने अपने सैनिकों से यीशु को कोड़े लगवाए। फिर उसने यीशु को क्रूस पर चढ़ाकर मार डालने के लिए सौंप दिया।

uk.L: Тоді відпустив їм Варавву, а Ісуса, збичувавши, передав [{{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}], щоб був розіпʼятий.
uk.B: Тож Пилат відпустив їм Варавву, як вони хотіли. Ісуса ж він звелів збичувати, а тоді передав {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} на розпʼяття.
uk.R: Тоді Пилат звільнив людям Варавву. Він звелів своїм воїнам бити Ісуса батогами. Потім він передав Ісуса, щоб {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} прибили до хреста.

ja.L: そのとき、[ピラトは]バラバを彼らに釈放した。しかしイエスはむち打ってから、十字架につけられるために引き渡した。
ja.B: そこでピラトは、彼らの望みどおりバラバを釈放した。そしてイエスをむち打たせてから、十字架につけるために引き渡した。
ja.R: そこでピラトは、人々のためにバラバを自由にしてやりました。そして兵士たちに、イエスをむちで打たせました。それから、十字架につけて殺すために、イエスを引き渡しました。

decisions.choice: flogged: beaten with a Roman whip
decisions.reason: The Roman whip had leather straps weighted with bits of bone or metal. Flogging came before crucifixion and left the victim badly weakened. Jesus had foretold it (20:19).

decisions.choice: handed over: the verb used all through for Jesus being given up
decisions.reason: Judas handed him to the leaders, the leaders handed him to Pilate (27:2), and now Pilate hands him over to death, as Jesus had said (20:18-19; 26:2).

decisions.choice: Pilate ordered (B); had his soldiers (R); as they wanted (B)
decisions.reason: Pilate gave the order; his soldiers did the flogging. Balanced and Readable say so.

decisions.choice: "đánh roi"
decisions.reason: The Roman flogging (meaning decision), as in the Vietnamese Mark 15:15.

decisions.choice: "채찍질하다" (L, B); "채찍으로 때리다" (R); Balanced and Readable say that Pilate had it done
decisions.reason: As in the Korean John 19:1 and Mark 15:15: beaten with a Roman whip (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "приказал бичевать" (B); "велел солдатам избить плетьми" (R)
decisions.reason: Pilate gave the order and his soldiers did the flogging; Balanced and Readable say so, as the English does.
